scope: All 71 repository feature requirements, including previously optional backends. Mapped tests establish only their stated automated scope. Full-feature qualification also requires retained observed scenario evidence and implementation completion.

journey.description: Run the stated scenario through public CLI/MCP/operator interfaces; retain prompts, revisions, assertions and final state.
journey.prerequisite: Installed Workbench and isolated website/mobile/research project state

workers.description: Product-owned real agents overlap, exchange evidence and produce independently verified artifacts; external development assistants are not product workers.
workers.prerequisite: Authenticated model harness and an actual coordinator-owned worker run

coordinator.description: Run the configured coordinator, inspect real agent/issue/run identities and reconcile process failures.
coordinator.prerequisite: Running configured Paperclip or exclusive qualified replacement coordinator

models.description: Probe actual installed harness/model/effort profiles and verify effective settings from real execution receipts.
models.prerequisite: Signed-in official CLI or explicitly configured API/local model provider

lcm.description: Actual LCM capture, fresh-process recall and cross-project rejection; preserve source identities.
lcm.prerequisite: Pinned running LCM installation with permitted history capture configured

summaries.description: Generate and expand summaries through multiple context windows and check originals, numeric qualifiers, revisions and unresolved contradictions.
summaries.prerequisite: Running context backend and a genuine summarizing model

qmd_exact.description: Real QMD indexes a project collection and retrieves exact terms without crossing collections.
qmd_exact.prerequisite: Built pinned QMD with project-bound collections

qmd_semantic.description: Real QMD semantic retrieval returns relevant passages for paraphrased queries and preserves source/project scope.
qmd_semantic.prerequisite: QMD semantic model and index installed with a held-out query set

corpus.description: Enumerate a mixed corpus larger than one model window; retain complete coverage denominator, exclusions, conflicts and bounded retrieval.
corpus.prerequisite: Mixed source corpus with known counts, versions and deliberately contradictory facts

retention.description: Delete or revoke a source across the active archive and configured external stores, retaining audited failures and backup retention boundaries.
retention.prerequisite: Configured real context stores plus disposable backup/index data

recovery.description: Five genuine fresh-model sessions recover sources and amendments; cumulative budgets and uncertain side effects remain fenced.
recovery.prerequisite: Actual coordinator, authenticated worker and controlled context/session rollover

capacity.description: Mixed interactive/background work exercises admission, pause, priorities, recovery and capacity limits with recorded latency and no lost prompts.
capacity.prerequisite: Running coordinator/worker pool and a bounded load generator

gui.description: Operate the actual WezTerm desktop: navigate, resize, submit, reconnect and inspect screenshots for the stated scenario.
gui.prerequisite: Installed WezTerm and a real graphical display on the target platform

brainstorm.description: Activated pinned Superpowers produces alternatives, constraints, tradeoffs and a reviewed decision from actual supplied evidence.
brainstorm.prerequisite: Pinned activated Superpowers procedures and a real reasoning worker

writing.description: Evaluate concise output for the stated audience while preserving quantities, negation, uncertainty and source meaning.
writing.prerequisite: Known-answer source corpus and independent editorial review rubric

procedures.description: Activate real pinned procedure checkouts; record hashes and block changed/missing procedures on resumed work.
procedures.prerequisite: Installed Superpowers, Elements of Style and Humanizer source checkouts

vale.description: Actual Vale clean/verbose controls and clear-writing/Humanizer workflow run; inspect alert JSON as well as process exit.
vale.prerequisite: Installed Vale and activated writing procedures

visuals.description: Render the actual output artifacts and inspect diagrams, tables, labels, layout and source-linked facts.
visuals.prerequisite: Generated HTML/SVG/document artifacts and a real rendering/inspection environment

languages.description: Build, test and introduce/reject deliberate regressions in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript and Rust projects.
languages.prerequisite: Python, Node/TypeScript and Rust toolchains with isolated test projects

calibration.description: Compare held-out human labels with model judges, report false accepts/rejects and prevent unsupported factual acceptance.
calibration.prerequisite: Human-labelled held-out examples and independent judge outputs

benchmark.description: Run held-out routing/model/outcome-finding scenarios and report every miss, latency and resource use without training on the answers.
benchmark.prerequisite: Qualified profiles and a versioned held-out benchmark with expected outcomes

soak.description: Run a 72-hour mixed whole-system soak including workers, faults, restart and storage pressure; retain loss and latency measurements.
soak.prerequisite: Long-running isolated deployment and controlled failure/load injection

packages.description: Build and independently install on supported platforms, verify pinned inputs and record dependency/artifact hashes.
packages.prerequisite: Fresh Linux/macOS environments and build/install tools

linked_contract.description: Read the actual linked project contract, execute compatible request/state/artifact exchanges and verify version mismatch handling.
linked_contract.prerequisite: Accessible linked-project specification and running peer integration

migration.description: Back up a customized installation, restore elsewhere, reconcile edits, validate new runtime and retire only identified old software.
migration.prerequisite: Disposable customized legacy installation plus current target evidence; never use real user data as a fixture

isolation.description: Attempt unauthorized cross-project/filesystem/network/credential access from actual constrained workers; retain denial and audit evidence.
isolation.prerequisite: Configured OS/container isolation and scoped worker credentials

openviking.description: Run a real OpenViking backend through project-scoped ingest/search/read/delete and restart; compare provenance with original sources.
openviking.prerequisite: Configured OpenViking server and its explicitly selected local/subscription/API model provider

hindsight.description: Run a real Hindsight bank through retain/recall/reflect/delete with scoped project mapping and inspect derived assertions.
hindsight.prerequisite: Configured Hindsight server and its explicitly selected local/subscription/API model provider

temporal.description: Execute tasks on the exclusive Temporal backend, interrupt/recover workers and verify signal/cancel/idempotency behavior.
temporal.prerequisite: Running Temporal service and registered Workbench workflow/activity worker

multi_host.description: Two actual hosts contend for work, exchange scoped evidence, lose connectivity and reconcile ownership without duplicate effects.
multi_host.prerequisite: Two isolated configured worker hosts and an authenticated coordinator

basic_memory.description: Real Basic Memory registers projects, writes/reads/searches notes across processes and rejects stale overwrites/cross-project access.
basic_memory.prerequisite: Installed Basic Memory with isolated project stores

notebook.description: Actual Open Notebook source ingestion and Ask produce traceable answers; verify its configured provider/auth profile and failure recovery.
notebook.prerequisite: Configured Open Notebook service with an explicitly supported inference provider

researcher.description: Actual GPT Researcher investigates authoritative web sources, includes contradictory evidence, and returns a bounded source-linked report.
researcher.prerequisite: Installed/configured GPT Researcher with working search and inference providers
